description: Grafana v2 example for vault-solver metrics. Uses example scrape labels namespace and pod; adapt selectors, grouping and table fields to your collection setup. Choose a Prometheus-compatible datasource. Counters cover the selected interval; current state uses current samples. Missing data is not a healthy state.

spec.title: Decision counts
spec.description: Every parsed auction contributes one bounded terminal decision. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Hot-path latency
spec.description: Percentiles of combined histogram buckets across selected pods. Per-pod p95 remains in Pod details; percentiles are not averaged.

spec.title: Bid amount funnel
spec.description: Bid amounts recorded at each lifecycle stage during the selected interval, in ETH. These are stage totals, not realised profit or a deduplicated amount across stages.

spec.title: Count conversion by pod
spec.description: Per-pod ratios of event counts within the selected interval. No activity means a zero denominator; missing metrics stay empty. These are interval ratios, not matched auction cohorts; lifecycle stages may cross time or pod boundaries.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="auction",outcome="enqueued"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="auction"}[$__range]))) >= 0) or ((sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="auction"}[$__range])) == 0) - 1)

((sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="won"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="enqueued"}[$__range]))) >= 0) or ((sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="enqueued"}[$__range])) == 0) - 1)

((sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_success"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="won"}[$__range]))) >= 0) or ((sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="won"}[$__range])) == 0) - 1)

spec.title: Feed connection history
spec.description: Feed continuity over the selected time range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Activity ages
spec.description: Current state-refresh age and ages of the latest bid lifecycle timestamps observed in the interval. Zero timestamps mean Not observed; missing samples stay empty.

spec.expr: clamp_min(time() - (max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="state_refresh",outcome="success"}) > 0), 0) or ((max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="state_refresh",outcome="success"}) == 0) - 1)

clamp_min(time() - (max by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="enqueued"}[$__range])) > 0), 0) or ((max by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="enqueued"}[$__range])) == 0) - 1)

clamp_min(time() - (max by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="won"}[$__range])) > 0), 0) or ((max by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="won"}[$__range])) == 0) - 1)

clamp_min(time() - (max by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_success"}[$__range])) > 0), 0) or ((max by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_success"}[$__range])) == 0) - 1)

spec.title: Won obligations
spec.description: Winning reservations still awaiting settlement. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Unresolved / failed / unsafe lifecycle
spec.description: Event counts in the selected interval for unresolved wins, breaker failures and failed settlements. deposit_below_floor is a current 0/1 flag, not an event count.

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="unresolved"}[$__range])), "signal", "unresolved_win", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="breaker",outcome="failure"}[$__range])), "signal", "breaker_failure", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_failed"}[$__range])), "signal", "failed_settlement", "", "") or label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (oev_deposit_below_floor{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}), "signal", "deposit_below_floor", "", "")

spec.title: Feeds connected
spec.description: Connected feeds / currently observed OEV pods. Missing feed samples do not count as connected. Retired pods are excluded from the denominator.

spec.expr: sum(min by (namespace, pod) (oev_feed_connected{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})) / count(max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev"}))

spec.title: Min deposit
spec.description: Minimum current Executor deposit across selected pods, in ETH. Replicas may share one signer and deposit; their balances are not additive. Inspect individual observations in Pod details.

spec.title: Pod details
spec.description: One row per pod observed in the selected interval. Counts cover the interval, including retired pods; feed and deposit are current samples. Deposits from replicas may describe the same funds.

title: Vault Solver · RedStone OEV

spec.name: pods
spec.label: Pods
spec.description: All expands to the pod names discovered for this solver and selected time range.
